## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behaviour. Include a concrete before/after example
when it helps a reviewer understand the change.

## Validation

List the relevant tests and native workflows checked. Link cross-platform build results
when packaging or runtime behaviour changes. Distinguish fixtures from live provider tests.

## Documentation and release impact

Note user-visible changes, updated guides, compatibility limits and packaging changes.
Keep customer inventories, credentials and local tooling state out of the pull request.
